Reranking with only a single document

```swift title="Swift"
import LiterLlm

let _req = try LiterLlm.rerankRequestFromJson("{\"documents\":[\"Artificial intelligence is the simulation of human intelligence.\"],\"model\":\"rerank-v3.5\",\"query\":\"What is AI?\"}")
let result = try await LiterLlm.rerank(req: _req)
debugPrint(result.results())
debugPrint(result.results()[0].relevanceScore())
```
